svg.text: A/P each: all 287 IDs; 96 exact common saved times, 0-5ms. Solver seed21 left; saved COMSOL right.
Observed active-position chords only. Independent stochastic paths are illustrative, not a pathwise accuracy gate.
Black dots: starts. Colored squares: retained numerical terminal states. Open blue circles: observed solver escapes.
Gray native crosses: last finite active observations before unknown disappearance; they are not inferred hit or escape positions.
Known solver boundary-event intervals break lines. Native intermediate reflections were not exported; unsaved bounces are not reconstructed.
The common canonical perimeter is a plotting reference, not native geometry-parity proof. Counts are computational particles.
